t: Lesson plans for building a small camera car and training it to drive itself.
steps: Find the AI Racing League lesson plans online.
Read the six week sample curriculum.
Plan two hour weekly sessions per the snippet.
Build the cars with a Raspberry Pi or NVIDIA Nano and a camera.
Set up the software and a track.
Ask IT to help with installs on Windows, Mac, or Linux.
Run a first driving test before students train a model.
